D&B data in Copilot Studio via MCP
Expands D&B’s distribution inside Microsoft’s AI tooling, potentially driving usage and ARR.
Could improve seller productivity and adoption among Dynamics users, aiding seat expansion.
Near real-time access to D&B Graph
Timeliness boosts utility for credit, compliance, and sales signals—key to monetization.
Lock-in via a standard ID can deepen integration and reduce customer churn.
Diversifies beyond sales/marketing into higher-value workflows with budget resilience.
